neet_bio_u09_t00_1.working: DNA is negatively charged because of its phosphate backbone, so it migrates towards the anode (positive electrode).

neet_bio_u09_t00_3.working: The PvuI site lies in the amp^R gene of pBR322. An insert there inactivates ampicillin resistance while tet^R stays intact, so recombinants grow on tetracycline but not on ampicillin.

neet_bio_u09_t00_4.working: The BamHI site lies in tet^R. An insert there inactivates tetracycline resistance, so A is true. pBR322 does carry ori and rop, so R is true, but R does not explain A.

neet_bio_u09_t00_5.working: Statement I is incorrect: a 6-bp site is expected once every 4^6 = 4096 bp, not 1024 bp. Statement II is correct: primers anneal first, then Taq polymerase extends them at about 72°C.
